cases.label: actual_8fb_candidate_with_no_archives
command:
from pathlib import Path
import json
import codeql_rust_profile as profile
actual = profile.tracked_lockfiles(Path.cwd())
assert actual == profile.WORKSPACE_LOCKFILES
assert len(actual) == 8
print(json.dumps(list(actual)))
